sections.title: By Keshav Srushti
sections.html:
Project Green Gold

By Keshav Srushti

Keshav Srushti's Gram Vikas Yojana is actively involved in making villages “Self-Sustainable” through its broad initiatives under verticals like Education, Health, Agriculture and Industry.

In year 2017, once Indian Forest Act was amended to remove “Bamboo” from the Tree category and bring it under the Grass category, it unlocked huge potential for Tribal communities for sustainable living through bamboo cultivation and harvesting.

Keshav Srushti built a business model around the bamboo crop that is Environment Friendly, Self-Sustaining, and Empowering for village communities—especially Tribal Women. This initiative was named “Project Green Gold”.

sections.title: Why Choose Bamboo?
sections.html:
Why Choose Bamboo?

Renewable Resource: Bamboo is one of the fastest-growing plants on earth, harvestable every 3 years without harming root systems or deforesting ecosystems.

Eco-Friendly & Carbon Neutral: Bamboo releases 35% more oxygen and absorbs up to 12 tons of carbon dioxide per hectare per year compared to standard timber trees.

Versatility and Durability: With tensile strength surpassing mild steel, bamboo crafts are resilient, stylish, and built for lasting lifetime daily use.

Biodegradable and Non-Toxic: Naturally pest-resistant and free from chemical treatments, ensuring healthy homes and zero long-term plastic pollution.

sections.html:
"Your One purchase illuminates two homes — your home and the tribal artisan's family in rural Palghar."
SUPPORTED BY NABARD • AN INITIATIVE OF KESHAV SRUSHTI

Loading handcrafted product details...

The Artisan's Touch & Heritage

Every piece is meticulously handcrafted by tribal women artisans belonging to the Vikramgad Bamboo Udyog Producer Company Limited. Harvested from local mature bamboo thickets in the rural forests of Palghar, each bamboo culm is seasoned, precision-cut, and manually lathed using time-honored tribal craftsmanship techniques passed down through generations.

By eliminating synthetic industrial resins and plastics, we preserve the natural grain, warmth, and strength of sustainable Indian bamboo while ensuring ethical wages and dignity of labor for our rural producers.

🤝
Empowering Tribal Women in 25+ Palghar Villages

Bamboo First operates in direct partnership with NABARD (National Bank for Agriculture and Rural Development) and Keshav Srushti to foster women's micro-enterprises and village self-reliance.

Technical Specifications

Primary Material 100% Solid Natural Bamboo (Bambusa tulda / Dendrocalamus strictus)
Dimensions (L x B x H) Standard Artisanal Specification
Surface Finish Non-toxic Herbal Oil Polish / Water-Resistant Food-Safe Seal
Production Method Handcrafted & Lathed by Tribal Artisans
Place of Origin Vikramgad, Palghar District, Maharashtra, India
Manufacturer / Producer Vikramgad Bamboo Udyog Producer Company Limited (Supported by NABARD & Keshav Srushti)
Eco Characteristics 100% Biodegradable, Carbon-Negative, Plastic-Free

Care & Longevity Guide

• Cleaning: Wipe gently with a soft damp cotton cloth. Avoid submerging in standing water or commercial dishwashers.

• Drying: Ensure the product is thoroughly air-dried in a shaded, well-ventilated spot if exposed to rain or moisture.

• Longevity Polish: Apply a light dab of pure coconut oil, linseed oil, or mineral oil once every 3-4 months to restore its glowing natural bamboo luster.

• End of Life: 100% compostable and biodegradable at the end of its multi-year lifespan, returning cleanly to Mother Earth.

Eco-Conscious Packaging & Safe Transit

• Zero Plastic Cushioning: We wrap every bamboo creation in biodegradable honeycomb kraft paper and natural jute cord.

• Crush-Tested Outer Box: Packed in double-walled corrugated shipping cartons designed to endure long transit without bending.

• Dispatch Timeline: Handcrafted orders are carefully inspected and dispatched within 24 to 48 hours directly from Vikramgad, Palghar.

• Replacement Guarantee: In the rare event of transit damage, we provide a no-questions-asked 7-day replacement.

sections.title: Who we are?
sections.html:
Our Identity

Who we are?

Welcome to the world of sustainable tourism presented by “Vikramgad Bamboo Udyog Producer Company Limited” (VBUPCL). VBUPCL is a Producer Company supported by NABARD for bamboo craft artisans of Vikramgad block in Palghar district.

It is an extension of the social initiative “Project Green Gold” led by Keshav Srushti since 2019 for skilling & entrepreneurship development of tribal women. Employment, Empowerment & Environment has been the core of the project. Hundreds of tribal lives have been transformed since then & Bamboo Ecotourism has been an essential part of this successful journey.

Our Mission

What we do?

We aim to create sustainable entrepreneurship opportunities for tribal communities through bamboo, with a special focus on empowering women, all while prioritising the protection of the natural environment.

We have built a bridge to connect urban people with rural ways of sustainable living that strive to preserve nature, culture, art, values, and traditions of Bharat.

sections.title: Section 4
What You Get?
sections.html:
Experience Authenticity

What You Get?

Immerse yourself in a range of activities that connect you with the heart of village life. Witness various organic farm produce as per the season, enjoy the lush green nature during monsoons, and listen to captivating stories narrated by pristine water bodies.

Get hands-on experience in making bamboo crafts, authentic Warli art, and much more. Live a day without gadgets and embrace a more human experience. Bring your family, and choose cheerfulness over materialism.

sections.title: Experience Eco Life First Hand
sections.html:
Experience Eco Life First Hand

A full-day immersive itinerary curated to rejuvenate your soul and support tribal artisans.

1. Traditional Welcome

Warm welcome amid vibrant rangolis, tribal tarpa dance, chiming lezims, and a refreshing cup of local herbal black tea.

2. Bamboo Craft Workshop

Hands-on guided workshop where master tribal artisans teach you how to cut, shape, and weave bamboo into beautiful articles.

3. Organic Village Lunch

Savour your tastebuds with authentic rustic lunch cooked on earthen stoves using fresh seasonal organic farm produce.

4. Guided Nature & Farm Walk

Explore local bamboo plantations, river streams, freshwater ponds, biodiversity corridors, and heritage village landmarks.

5. Warli Art Workshop

Learn the geometric sacred folklore of authentic Warli painting directly from indigenous tribal Warli artists.

6. Folk Dance & Souvenirs

Join the rhythm in the joyous Gauri nritya folk dance and shop affordable handcrafted bamboo souvenirs directly from artisans.

sections.title: Our Story
sections.html:
The Genesis

Our Story

Bamboo has long been a symbol of resilience, positivity, and strength — qualities that resonate deeply with humanity's journey. This remarkable plant, revered for its 1,500+ documented uses, has the potential to transform lives and entire rural communities, as envisioned by our visionary former Prime Minister, Shri Atal Bihari Vajpayee.

In 2004, at the seventh World Bamboo Congress in New Delhi, he foresaw bamboo's incredible economic value, predicting its ability to lift millions out of poverty and contribute significantly to India's economy. His words planted the seeds of a movement that would take shape years later.

In 2014, another visionary leader, Prime Minister Shri Narendra Modi, reignited the call for Atmanirbharta (self-reliance). Meanwhile, our mentor organization, Keshav Srushti, was tirelessly working on rural development through initiatives like solar-powered irrigation under the Keshav Srushti Gram Vikas Yojana (KSGVY).

By 2017, KSGVY turned PM Vajpayee's prophetic vision into action with Project Green Gold. This initiative trained underprivileged tribal women from five villages in Wada taluka in the art of bamboo handicrafts, offering them a sustainable livelihood beyond seasonal farming. After three years of rigorous development, the community launched its first signature product — the handcrafted bamboo rakhi.

This newfound empowerment bore fruit even during the challenges of the COVID-19 pandemic. Villages in Palghar district delivered over 50,000 bamboo rakhis in 2020 and over 8,000 bamboo lanterns (kandeels) in subsequent years. The product range expanded to 100+ creations, spanning festive, devotional, home, lifestyle, and gifting categories. A global milestone came when the community successfully fulfilled an international export order of 500 bamboo auto rickshaws for the UK, showcasing their world-class design capabilities.

In 2023, on the auspicious occasion of Gudi Padwa, the Vikramgad Bamboo Udyog Producer Company Limited was formally registered — India's first tribal women-led rural agri-startup. Shortly after, Bamboo First was launched, introducing the world to our unique e-commerce platform of bamboo products crafted with care and purpose.

Today, Bamboo First stands as a testament to the strength of community, the power of sustainability, and the spirit of tribal women who are building a self-reliant future. Through every product we create, we celebrate a journey rooted in tradition and growing towards empowerment.

Principles that guide every piece we carve, every artisan we support, and every partnership we build.

Love & Compassion for Environment

“वृक्षवल्ली आम्हा सोयरी वनचरे, पक्षीही सुस्वरे। आळविती।।”

These sacred words of Sant Tukaram Maharaj evoke our eternal compassion for trees, forest ecology, and all living beings.

Empowerment for All

In our mission of atmanirbharta, we aspire and work tirelessly towards the financial and social self-reliance of every individual in our tribal community.

Customer Above Everyone Else

Our customers are honored patrons and in their wellbeing lies our welfare. We provide the highest craftsmanship that offers optimum lifetime value and pure natural joy.

sections.html: Media & Press Highlights

sections.title: Section 3
sections.html:
23rd Nov 2023 • Palghar

'Bhoomi Poojan' Ceremony for CFC Construction at Balkapra Village

Vikramgad Bamboo Udyog Producers Company Ltd (VBUPCL) and Keshav Srushti conducted the sacred 'Bhoomi Poojan' ceremony of their Common Facility Centre (CFC) at Balkapra Village in Jawahar block.

This state-of-the-art facility is dedicated to empowering tribal communities by providing bamboo-centric skill training, modern processing, exhibition, and direct marketing for handicrafts curated by tribal women. The facility is situated within a dense plantation of 5,500 bamboo saplings across 15 acres of tribal land.

National Recognition • Episode 96

Featured in Hon'ble PM Narendra Modi's Mann Ki Baat

Hon. Prime Minister of Bharat Shri Narendra Modi mentioned our grassroots effort in the 96th edition of 'Mann Ki Baat' with a featured video of our tribal women artisans crafting bamboo articles in Vikramgad.

“Sustainability is the buzzword all over the world, and the true answer lies in being close to nature. 'Bamboo First' is providing effective solutions with bamboo as a medium to fight climate change and empower rural tribal communities with dignifying employment.”

International Milestone • Export Success

500 Bamboo Auto Rickshaws Exported to the UK

Showcasing precision craft and design ingenuity, our tribal women artisans successfully fulfilled an international order of 500 handcrafted miniature bamboo auto-rickshaws for clients in the United Kingdom.

This accomplishment proved that rural tribal artisans equipped with proper design mentoring can compete on global platforms with zero compromise on quality and environmental integrity.
